news.title: News
news.earlierText: Since 2001, more than 70 news outlets and programs in at least 15 countries have covered Prof. Carr’s research. They include The Economist ({economist}, 2006, on how space suits shape the way astronauts walk and run), The New York Times, NPR, CNN, ABC News, Wired (in a “Muppet-vetted” guide to walking on the Moon), New Scientist, Popular Science, MIT Technology Review, the BBC, Space.com, NBC News, and Ars Technica. In Japan, Nikkei, NHK, and the Yomiuri Shimbun covered the 2026 nanogap study. Coverage spans newspapers, magazines, radio and television (including the National Geographic Channel and Discovery Channel Canada), online science news, podcasts, and talks. Topics range from space-suit design and locomotion (2001–2011) to the search for life on Mars, Venus, and ocean worlds.
